a3-remote-monitoring-technologies.name: A3 Remote Monitoring Technologies Pvt Ltd
a3-remote-monitoring-technologies.note: A3's remote patient monitoring technology for cardiac cases aligns with wearable health monitors that enable continuous health tracking and data transmission for clinical management.
a3-remote-monitoring-technologies.project_type: Wearable health monitors and implantable biosensors

acuradyne-medical-systems.name: Acuradyne Medical Systems Pvt Ltd
acuradyne-medical-systems.note: Acuradyne's arterial pulse wave analyzer is a wearable/portable diagnostic device that monitors cardiovascular function, fitting directly under the wearable health monitors category within Medical Devices & Diagnostics.
acuradyne-medical-systems.project_type: Wearable health monitors and implantable biosensors

advanced-renewable-tandem-photovoltaics-.name: Advanced Renewable Tandem-Photovoltaics India Pvt Ltd
advanced-renewable-tandem-photovoltaics-.note: Advanced tandem photovoltaic technology directly develops solar cells with higher power conversion efficiency, which is the core innovation focus of sub-sector 1.3 for next-generation solar cells.

albatross-energetics.name: Albatross Energetics Pvt Ltd
albatross-energetics.note: Albatross Energetics develops novel air conditioning technology that reduces energy consumption and carbon footprint, which directly aligns with the high-efficiency air conditioner innovation focus under the Energy-Efficient Cooling sub-sector.

algosurg-inc.name: Algosurg Inc
algosurg-inc.note: Algosurg's conversion of 2D X-ray images to 3D surgical planning models is an image-guided surgical technology that directly supports surgical planning and execution.

amyscan-healthcare.name: Amyscan Healthcare Pvt Ltd
amyscan-healthcare.note: AmyScan's development of diagnostic tests for detecting amyloid seeds in circulation aligns with point-of-care diagnostic kit development for disease detection and management.

atomberg-technologies.name: Atomberg Technologies Pvt Ltd
atomberg-technologies.note: Atomberg's energy-efficient fan technology addresses demand-side efficiency in residential and commercial cooling/ventilation, which is not covered by the taxonomy—sub-sector 1.10 focuses on high-efficiency air conditioners and supply chain resilience for cooling systems, but does not include fan efficiency innovations as a project type.

aubotz-labs.name: Aubotz Labs Pvt Ltd
aubotz-labs.note: Aubotz's intelligent autonomous floor cleaning robots require autonomous navigation systems and perception capabilities to operate independently in industrial environments.

auflows-cardiotech.name: Auflows CardioTech Pvt Ltd
auflows-cardiotech.note: Auflows develops a cardiovascular implantation device for congenital heart disease surgery, which directly aligns with implant-based medical devices for cardio-respiratory care.
auflows-cardiotech.project_type: Implants (bone, cochlear, pacemaker), neural chip implants and wound healing materials

ayu-devices.name: Ayu Devices Pvt Ltd
ayu-devices.note: Ayu Devices' digital stethoscope module is a wearable diagnostic device that converts analog acoustic signals into digital data for health monitoring, fitting squarely within medical devices and wearable health monitor technologies.
ayu-devices.project_type: Wearable health monitors and implantable biosensors

babblebots-ai-inc-mystinaai-labs.name: Babblebots.AI Inc/ MystinaAI Labs Pvt Ltd
babblebots-ai-inc-mystinaai-labs.note: The company's AI/NLP voice bot for job applicant screening is an HR automation tool that does not fit Sector 3's focus on agriculture, health, education, or cross-domain enabling technologies—it addresses recruitment/HR processes which are outside this sector's defined scope.

bhugol-gis.name: Bhugol GIS Pvt Ltd
bhugol-gis.note: Bhugol GIS specializes in Geographical Information Systems and image processing, which are foundational technologies for remote sensing applications in smart farming and agricultural monitoring systems.
bhugol-gis.project_type: Smart farming systems leveraging IoT, AI and remote sensing

botsrule.name: Botsrule Pvt Ltd
botsrule.note: Botsrule's water distribution management solution is a utility infrastructure optimization tool that does not align with any subsector in Sector 5; it falls outside the digital economy taxonomy which focuses on digital/computing innovation rather than physical water resource infrastructure management.

c-tech-labs.name: C-tech Labs Pvt Ltd
c-tech-labs.note: The Solar Rice Cookers directly address decentralized energy solutions for off-grid and rural applications, fitting the sub-sector's focus on solar home systems and last-mile energy access, though the carbogen delivery system and LED products fall outside the energy transition taxonomy.
c-tech-labs.project_type: Solar home systems, micro-hydro, biomass gasification for rural areas

carenx-innovations.name: CareNx Innovations Pvt Ltd
carenx-innovations.note: CareNx's mobile-based prenatal care solution uses AI/ML to identify high-risk pregnancies through diagnostic screening in remote settings, fitting the profile of AI-powered diagnostic technology rather than hardware devices, wearables, or traditional medical devices.

carimo-technologies.name: Carimo Technologies Pvt Ltd
carimo-technologies.note: CAPMAC Edge is an AI-powered industrial maintenance device built on MCU platform for real-time monitoring and predictive analysis, directly aligning with edge-AI hardware deployment capabilities in resource-constrained environments.
carimo-technologies.project_type: Edge-AI hardware for deployment in low-resource and rural settings

chainworks-digital.name: Chainworks Digital Pvt Ltd
chainworks-digital.note: Chainworks Digital's blockchain-based organ transplant management system is a healthcare IT/logistics solution for transplant coordination, not a biotechnology, biomanufacturing, pharmaceutical, medical device, biomaterial, or therapeutic development project—the taxonomy lacks digital health infrastructure and organ procurement/allocation technologies.

choira-musictech.name: Choira Musictech Pvt Ltd
choira-musictech.note: Choira's work on low-latency remote music collaboration and production falls outside the defined sub-sectors of Sector 5, which focus on agriculture, fintech, governance, health, education, data platforms, and digital infrastructure—not creative industry applications or real-time audio collaboration technologies.
